leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply CSS custom properties to define a theme palette for components
Construct a Vue component that consumes theme variables for styling
Configure a parent component to provide theme data to child components
Implement dynamic theme switching by binding to reactive state
Integrate theme variables with component props for customizable theming
Manipulate theme values through computed properties for derived styles
Initialize a theme system using Vue's provide/inject pattern
